over.heroSubtitle: Family business, yacht broker and DIY yard in one — the trusted address in Roermond for over fifty years.
over.story1: What started in 1972 as a small yard has grown into the largest yacht broker and self-service yard in Limburg. We kept the yard deliberately compact and human — craftspeople who know you, on a site that feels familiar.
over.story2: We combine craftsmanship with transparent prices and modern methods. Every boat is treated as if it were our own.
over.hiswaDesc: Fully insured yard with camera surveillance and controlled maintenance.
over.craftTitle: Everything in one hand on the Maasplassen
over.craft1: Our 10,000 m² yard is set up for DIY boaters as well as clients who hand over the full maintenance. With our 30-ton gantry crane, professional pressure-wash installation and modern hydraulic boat transporter, we move every vessel safely and efficiently.
over.craft2: By keeping everything in-house — from crane to storage, from repair to brokerage — quality and planning stay consistent. You get personal contact and short lines.

werf.heroTitle: One yard, one contact, every service
werf.heroSubtitle: At Krekelberg Nautic you can have everything done — craning, washing, winter storage, repairs, hall rental and yacht brokerage.
werf.intro: On the yard you can work on your boat yourself or hire an independent mechanic. From Raymarine electronics to Vetus bow thruster installation, from gelcoat repairs to osmosis treatments — all in one place.

crane.title: Crane up to 30 tons
crane.p1: Your boat is lifted with a modern 30-ton gantry crane. Before placement on stands we clean the underwater hull with a professional pressure-wash installation and wash the hull with shampoo.
crane.p2: Your boat enters winter clean. In spring after sanding and degreasing you can immediately start applying antifouling.

wash.title: Hull pressure wash
wash.p1: Right after craning we clean your hull with high-pressure water. A clean hull means less drag, longer antifouling action and a better state for your boat.
wash.p2: We work eco-friendly with filtered runoff according to our environmental permit.

storage.title: Winter storage
storage.p1: Our storage is suitable for both polyester and steel boats of various sizes and weights. We have a spacious 10,000 m² site, more than 200 solid stands and modern lift and transport equipment.
storage.p2: The site is fully fenced, closed at night with an electric gate and guarded day and night. During opening hours there's always someone on site.

diy.title: Work on your own boat
diy.p1: Krekelberg Nautic is THE DIY yard of Limburg. You can independently work on your own boat at our yard, or bring in an external mechanic under clear yard conditions.
diy.p2: For those who'd rather hand over the work, our mechanics can do everything for you — from small maintenance to complete refits.

hall.title: Hall rental
hall.p1: For refits, painting or long-term work we rent out a covered hall. Your boat stays dry and you can work comfortably regardless of the weather.
hall.p2: Per week, month or season — flexible arrangements with power/water connection included by default.

brokerage.title: Yacht brokerage
brokerage.p1: As the largest yacht broker in Limburg we help you with sale and purchase of your boat. Our physical sales location and Schepenkring partnership ensure maximum visibility.
brokerage.p2: At least 75 boats for sale on location, personal guidance from intake to transfer.

werf.faqSubtitle: The questions we get most often about storage, craning and works.

faq1.q: Why is wintering on shore recommended?
faq1.a: Wintering on shore reduces the chance of damage. For polyester boats it significantly reduces the risk of osmosis. For steel boats it helps prevent corrosion. Winter is also ideal for maintenance and repairs.

faq2.q: What are the risks if my boat stays in the water in winter?
faq2.a: In extreme cold Rijkswaterstaat may pull the weirs, which can cause the water level in the Maas and surrounding harbours to drop suddenly by several meters. This can lead to severe damage and high repair costs.

faq3.q: How safe is my boat during storage?
faq3.a: The site is fully fenced, closed at night with an electric gate and guarded day and night. During opening hours there's always someone on site (except during the Christmas holidays).

faq4.q: What facilities are on the site?
faq4.a: The site has multiple power connections and water taps. The layout ensures you're always close to a connection point.

faq5.a: Costs depend on type and size of your boat. For current pricing and to book, please contact us — no obligation.

werf.ctaBody: Book a crane slot, request a quote or visit our yard in Roermond — no obligation.

afspuiten.heroSubtitle: We pressure wash your hull immediately after lifting. A clean hull reduces drag, extends antifouling performance and keeps your boat in better condition.
afspuiten.priceFootnote: Prices by length class, including VAT. The final price depends on the exact length of your boat.
afspuiten.description: Our pressure washing system removes algae, sludge and deposits deep in the surface. Filtered drainage protects the environment. Optional hull inspections and antifouling advice are available.
afspuiten.feature1Description: Dirt has not dried out yet, giving the best cleaning result.
afspuiten.feature2Description: We collect deposits in accordance with our environmental permit.
afspuiten.feature3Description: Visual checks for blistering and osmosis.
afspuiten.feature4Description: Ready for antifouling or storage within 24 hours.
afspuiten.feature5Description: Our team has worked on the same boats for many years.
afspuiten.feature6Description: Motorboats, sailing boats and launches: we adjust pressure and technique.
afspuiten.faq1Question: How long does pressure washing take?
afspuiten.faq1Answer: Usually 15 to 30 minutes, depending on length and the amount of fouling.
afspuiten.faq2Question: Can I combine pressure washing with other services?
afspuiten.faq2Answer: Yes, we recommend combining it with lifting and, if needed, antifouling. Ask our yard about the options.
afspuiten.faq3Question: What happens to the collected waste?
afspuiten.faq3Answer: A certified waste contractor disposes of it in accordance with our environmental permit.
afspuiten.faq4Question: Is the service available in peak season?
afspuiten.faq4Answer: Yes, but slots fill up. Book at least two weeks ahead in March–May and October–November.

winterstalling.heroSubtitle: Indoor and outdoor storage on an insured yard of over 10,000 m² in Roermond. We care for your boat as if it were our own.
winterstalling.priceFootnote: Winter storage prices by length class, including VAT, two lifts and pressure washing. The final price depends on your boat’s exact length.
winterstalling.description: Krekelberg Nautic offers winter and summer storage with optional winter preparation. Work on your boat yourself or leave maintenance to our mechanics. Insurance and 24/7 camera surveillance are included as standard.
winterstalling.feature1Description: Both with cover for masts and sun protection.
winterstalling.feature2Description: A fully insured location with camera surveillance.
winterstalling.feature3Description: Work on or visit your boat during opening hours.
winterstalling.feature4Description: Available on request as an option.
winterstalling.feature5Description: External mechanics are welcome under our yard conditions.
winterstalling.feature6Description: Lifting and pressure washing in one package.
winterstalling.faq1Question: When does the storage season start?
winterstalling.faq1Answer: Winter storage runs from 1 November to 30 April. Summer storage is available from 1 May to 31 October.
winterstalling.faq2Question: Can I carry out maintenance during storage?
winterstalling.faq2Answer: Yes. During opening hours you can access the yard, work areas, water and electricity.
winterstalling.faq3Question: Is my boat insured during storage?
winterstalling.faq3Answer: Our yard is insured. We recommend keeping your own hull insurance.
winterstalling.faq4Question: How is my boat placed on its cradle?
winterstalling.faq4Answer: We adjust the cradles to your boat type. You receive a photo of its placement.

weekje_op_wal.heroSubtitle: Lift your boat out of the water and spend a week maintaining it at our yard. We discuss the schedule and options for your boat in advance.
weekje_op_wal.description: A week ashore gives you time to work on your boat. Discuss your preferred dates, lifting and facilities with us. Our yard supports DIY maintenance and help from our mechanics by appointment.
weekje_op_wal.priceFootnote: Prices by length class, including VAT. Contact us for availability and to agree what the package includes.
weekje_op_wal.feature1Description: Set aside time to give your boat some attention.
weekje_op_wal.feature2Description: Discuss your planned work with us in advance.
weekje_op_wal.feature3Description: Ask about work areas, electricity and water.
weekje_op_wal.feature4Description: Discuss in advance whether our mechanics can help.
weekje_op_wal.feature5Description: Agree your preferred dates and lifting schedule with us.
weekje_op_wal.feature6Description: View indicative prices based on your boat’s length.
weekje_op_wal.faq1Question: How do I book a week ashore?
weekje_op_wal.faq1Answer: Contact us to discuss your preferred dates and lifting schedule.
weekje_op_wal.faq2Question: Can I do the work myself?
weekje_op_wal.faq2Answer: Yes, DIY maintenance is possible under the yard conditions. Discuss the facilities you need in advance.
weekje_op_wal.faq3Answer: Our mechanics can help by appointment. Contact us in advance to discuss the options.
weekje_op_wal.faq4Answer: The price depends on your boat’s length class. Displayed prices are indicative; contact us to agree the details and availability.

zelf_werken.heroTitle: Work on your boat at our yard
zelf_werken.heroSubtitle: Combine our facilities with your own skills. Our yard supports DIY boat owners with work areas, tools and advice.
zelf_werken.description: You can work on your own boat at our yard under the yard conditions. We provide work areas, electricity and water. Our mechanics can answer questions or carry out specialist work. External mechanics are welcome if registered.
zelf_werken.feature4Description: With valid liability insurance and VCA certification.
zelf_werken.feature5Description: Screws, paint, adhesives and oil on site.
zelf_werken.faq1Question: What work can I carry out myself?
zelf_werken.faq1Answer: Maintenance, painting, polishing and small repairs. Welding and battery or gas installation work must be registered in advance.
zelf_werken.faq2Question: Can I bring my own mechanic?
zelf_werken.faq2Answer: Yes, with liability insurance and valid VCA certification. Register at reception.
zelf_werken.faq3Answer: Always follow barriers and environmental rules. No open flames or waste on the ground. Leave the work area tidy.
zelf_werken.faq4Answer: Yes, suppliers can deliver directly to the yard. We notify you by text message when your package arrives.
